title: Property completion delayed by frozen digital bank account
summary:
A homebuyer in Oxfordshire faced potential completion delays after digital bank Revolut froze access to a £37,000 house deposit during a "routine security review". The account holder's wife had her account suspended for nearly three weeks, restricting access to funds needed for property completion.

title: London parking fees for home movers reach £440 in some boroughs
summary:
Home movers in London face parking charges of up to £440 to reserve space for removal vans, with costs varying significantly across the capital's boroughs. Research shows Haringey charges the highest fee at £440, nearly double the previous year's rate, while Sutton charges nothing.

title: Landlord confidence falls to 23% despite strong profitability
summary:
Landlord confidence has declined sharply over the past 15 years despite maintaining strong financial performance, according to research by Pegasus Insight. The analysis found that just 23% of landlords are confident about their business prospects, down from 63% in 2011.

title: Landlords face £36,000 additional tax over 25 years
summary:
New analysis has quantified the financial impact of recent income tax increases on buy-to-let landlords, with projections showing significant long-term costs for property investors across England. Landlords in London face an additional £36,000 in tax over 25 years, according to calculations by Rathbones.

title: Your First Home scheme caps cover 46% of new-build sales
summary:
Government price caps for the Your First Home scheme would have covered 46% of new-build homes sold in England last year. Regional variations show significant differences, with 58% of new-builds in London falling within thresholds compared to 40% in the South West and North East.

title: Rightmove extends Women in Estate Agency partnership
summary:
Property portal Rightmove has extended its partnership with Women in Estate Agency for a further two years, extending the agreement until 31 July 2028. The renewed partnership will fund WiEA's annual flagship event, UK-wide Regional Champions network, and practical training programme.

title: Southwold leads seaside property price growth over decade
summary:
Southwold in Suffolk has recorded the highest property price growth among UK seaside locations over the past decade, with prices increasing 94% from £231,236 to £448,106. Sandbanks in Dorset ranked second with a 93% increase, while Saltburn-by-the-Sea saw a 75% rise over the same period.

title: Saudi Arabia property market faces short-term pressure
summary:
A property advisory firm has outlined the current state of the Saudi Arabian real estate market following recent regional security incidents, presenting economic forecasts showing a projected 3.3% contraction in 2026 followed by a 7.9% rebound in 2027.

title: DarGlobal announces seven FENDI Casa mansions in Riyadh
summary:
DarGlobal has announced seven mansions with FENDI Casa interiors at Rayana, Wadi Safar, marking the first FENDI Casa residential collection in Saudi Arabia. The six- and seven-bedroom homes on plots from 2,035 to 4,623 square metres are scheduled for completion in December 2029.
